SELECT a.`transaction_time`, a.`user_card`, a.`transaction_money`, a.`balance`, a.`transaction_type`, a.`dep_name`, a.`transaction_channel`, a.`order_id`, a.`subsidy_begin_date`, a.`subsidy_end_date`, a.`transaction_status`, b.`user_serial`, b.`user_no`, b.`user_name` FROM `amount_change_record` a LEFT JOIN `account` b ON a.`user_card` = b.`user_card`
1=1
and a.`transaction_type`=#{param.transactionType}
and b.`user_card` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.`user_serial` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.`user_no` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.`user_name` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%')
and a.`transaction_time` between to_timestamp(#{startTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
order by a.transaction_time desc

SELECT (( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 1 THEN a.transaction_money ELSE 0 END ))-( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 11 THEN a.transaction_money ELSE 0 END ))) AS '消费金额', ( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 11 THEN a.transaction_money ELSE 0 END )) AS '退款金额', (( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 3 THEN a.transaction_money ELSE 0 END ))-( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 11 THEN a.transaction_money ELSE 0 END ))) AS '充值金额', ( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 5 THEN a.transaction_money ELSE 0 END )) AS '补贴金额' FROM amount_change_record a LEFT JOIN account b ON a.user_card = b.user_card
1=1
and b.user_card like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_serial like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_no like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%')
and a.transaction_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
